The '''85th Infantry''', or '''Eighty-fifth''', was a [[battalion/Legends|battalion]] of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] who [[Battle of Haurgab|fought]] on [[Haurgab]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The clones of the [[14th Infantry]] joined the unit. Two [[Company/Legends|companies]] of the 85th&mdash;fewer than 300 troopers&mdash; supported the regional government on [[Hadde]] while the rest of the battalion was divided into [[Platoon/Legends|platoons]] across the region.<ref name="O66" />

*''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]''
